arkvian:minion/holybird1.rationale: Locked approved scheme; shifts the golden feathers toward jade while retaining the white plumage and dark outlines.

base:minion/anteater_1.rationale: Turns the line's steel-blue plating into warm rose brass while leaving the red cables and dark mechanical outlines recognizable.

base:minion/armadillo_1.rationale: Turns the lavender metal plates and spikes toward warm copper while keeping the pale armor highlights and dark circular details readable across both stages.

base:minion/batdemon_1.rationale: Lifts the cool, low-saturation body and wing membranes into ash-gray with a faint blue cast, while shifting the warm horns, claws, and markings to crimson; the neutral mask excludes bright highlights and near-black outlines.

base:minion/bluebell_1.rationale: Recolors the bell's golden body and trim to vivid jade, keeping its blue flame and face as contrasting accents.

base:minion/chameleon_1.rationale: Rotates the vivid rainbow scales into a cohesive cool aurora of blues, violets, and greens while leaving low-saturation eye and claw details largely intact.

base:minion/cheetah_1.rationale: Turns the line’s dominant golden fur into vivid rose while leaving the electric blue markings distinct.

base:minion/crow_1.rationale: Sets chromatic areas to blood red across the egg and feather stages, while low-value bodies and neutral bone masks retain their contrast.

base:minion/dc2guy_1.rationale: Recolors the prominent gold armor and circuitry to bright cobalt blue, preserving the gray joints, dark suit, and brown hat as contrasting details.

base:minion/demonic_cat_1.rationale: The preview shifted the eyes and neon accents blue but left the charcoal fur nearly unchanged. Map colored pixels to amethyst and use a mild midtone tint to carry that hue into the broad dark fur without tinting black outlines.

base:minion/dogeel_1.rationale: Maps the chromatic body and fins to amber-gold so both stages read warm and coordinated, with pale eyes and deep mouth shadows left intact.

base:minion/evileye_1.rationale: Moves the broad crimson membranes and tendrils toward deep teal, letting the many green irises remain bright focal points through all three forms.

base:minion/fire_bear_1.rationale: The preview only recolored the lava seams. Map chromatic details to cyan and add a mild cyan tint to the broad gray midtones while retaining neutral highlights and dark outlines.

base:minion/fire_frog_1.rationale: A strong all-hue turn converts the red-orange lava and dark volcanic tones to an icy cyan-blue fire palette across all three stages.

base:minion/fire_pig_1.rationale: Locked approved scheme; shifts the orange-red fur and flame markings toward amethyst violet across all three stages while retaining neutral eyes and dark outlines.

base:minion/fireghost_1.rationale: Changes the large golden hood and robe panels to sapphire-blue, leaving the dark robe and blue spectral flames legible.

base:minion/flyinggrasssuperminion_1.rationale: Turns the large green scales into orchid-violet while retaining the red crest, yellow belly and blue jewelry as a lively multicolor design.

base:minion/goo_1.rationale: Changes the bright green slime bodies to saturated blackberry purple while keeping their white eyes and dark mouths distinct across all three shapes.

base:minion/grassgorilla_1.rationale: Moves the broad green body and cactus armor toward cobalt while preserving the orange-red mane as a warm counterpoint.

base:minion/grasssnake_1.rationale: Recolors the dominant lime-green bodies to bright rose pink while preserving the orange frills and pale bellies.

base:minion/griffen_1.rationale: Shifts the deep violet feathered crests toward ruby red, keeping the golden bodies and orange eyes as warm contrasting features in both stages.

base:minion/ground_plant_1.rationale: Turns the large purple plant bodies into copper-orange across the three forms while the lime leaves and pale spots remain contrasting details.

base:minion/groundattacker_1.rationale: Changes the deep purple armor to sharp chartreuse, while its ivory horns and claws continue to frame the darker silhouette.

base:minion/groundmole_1.rationale: Turns the broad earthy brown bodies toward icy blue while leaving the steel claws and sandy ground accents as material contrast through the line.

base:minion/harpy_1.rationale: Changes the large rust-red wings and body to cyan-teal; cream feather sections and dark outlines retain their contrast.

base:minion/healinghorse_1.rationale: Maps the teal body and green mane to deep burgundy, with pale markings kept as a high-value contrast.

base:minion/holyfox_1.rationale: Recolors the fox's vivid red-orange coat and tail to sapphire blue, while the cream chest and blue flame remain clear accents.

base:minion/holymantris_1.rationale: Recolors the prominent coral-red limbs and shell plates to indigo while preserving the pale body and cream accents.

base:minion/holystrongguy_1.rationale: Turns the blue body into ruby red while preserving the polished gold armor for a clear red-and-gold holy design.

base:minion/hummingbird_1.rationale: Jade eye and accent recoloring plus restrained jade tint in gray metal midtones; bright silver highlights remain neutral.

base:minion/icebird_1.rationale: Maps the blue eyes and chest marks to copper-orange and gives the broad off-white feather midtones a slight warm tint; bright white highlights and dark outlines remain neutral.

base:minion/icedeer_1.rationale: Gives the blue frost antlers and muted body a celadon-green sheen; the neutral midtone tint catches pale ice while protecting white highlights and dark details.

base:minion/icetree_1.rationale: Turns the dense green foliage toward amber and gold while preserving the white snow cap and brown limbs across both stages.

base:minion/jellyfish_1.rationale: Maps the broad pink bell to lime-chartreuse and lightly tints the evolved form’s pale chromatic tentacle midtones, leaving bright white linework and blue water effects cool.

base:minion/landshark_1.rationale: Recolors the shark's blue-gray hide to copper and bronze while retaining its orange gills and dark features.

base:minion/lichboss_1.rationale: Moves the blue cloth, spectral accents, and cool armor details toward rose magenta while retaining the gold armor and bone faces across all three forms.

base:minion/pinkbell_1.rationale: Turns the bell’s broad yellow-gold body into fresh lime-green, retaining the magenta flame and band as a strong accent.

base:minion/racoon_1.rationale: Pushes the brown fur and mask markings into lilac and plum, while the black paws, nose and blue eye accents stay legible.

base:minion/raptor_1.rationale: A broad hue turn converts the red-orange scales and shell markings to sapphire and teal tones, preserving the dark stripes and pale egg shell through the evolution.

base:minion/robobull_1.rationale: Recolors the bull’s large red armor panels to cyan, while the gold trim and dark joints preserve the mechanical detailing.

base:minion/roboshark_1.rationale: Converts the metallic blue and cyan body into copper-orange plating, preserving dark joints and bright eye details.

base:minion/scarecrow_1.rationale: Shifts the red clothing and pumpkin details toward deep teal, with the straw limbs, brown hats, and dark outlines keeping the harvest silhouettes readable.

base:minion/scorpion_1.rationale: Turns the broad orange-yellow armor and stingers toward blue-cyan across all three forms; charcoal sections remain dark.

base:minion/slenderman_1.rationale: Adds a rose-mauve tint to the pale body and pink face details; the opt-in neutral midtone tint makes the single-stage change visible while bright highlights and the dark face stay distinct.

base:minion/tiger_1.rationale: Locked approved scheme; shifts the orange coat and stripes toward moonstone blue across both stages while retaining the pale muzzle, belly, and dark markings.

base:minion/tikimonkey_1.rationale: Moves the broad orange and red masks and fur into deep blue-violet across both stages, retaining the wooden and gold accents.

base:minion/titan_1.rationale: Turns the green crocodilian scales into ruby and burgundy while keeping gold ornaments and pale teeth as warm accents.

base:minion/titan_2.rationale: Recolors the deep blue scales and armor to rich jade, keeping the gold trim and white mane as bright royal accents.

base:minion/tortoise_1.rationale: Pushes the icy blue shell facets toward violet-rose; the broad cream shell plates stay neutral, so the recolor is concentrated in the colored ice details.

base:minion/trex_1.rationale: Recolors the green dinosaur hide to copper-orange but leaves the beige claws, teeth and belly highlights intact.

base:minion/undeadeel_1.rationale: Maps the chromatic body and slime to ember-red/orange while preserving dark shadows and pale details.

base:minion/waterbird_1.rationale: Shifts the line’s dominant blue and teal plumage to orange-red, including the large final-stage wings, while retaining yellow and pale markings.

base:minion/waterhorse_1.rationale: Changes the blue dragon's body and horns to garnet and crimson, while its golden mane remains a contrasting feature.

base:minion/waterseal_1.rationale: Shifts the blue water splashes and cool seal markings toward lilac, leaving the white bodies and brown-gray flippers untouched across both stages.

base:minion/worm_1.rationale: Recolors the broad tan and warm brown bodies to cobalt-blue across all three stages, keeping the green mouth and dark contour details distinct.

ice_floor:minion/imammoth1.rationale: Maps the icy and thawed coats across all three stages to amber-orange, using a small neutral midtone tint to carry the warm palette into muted thaw colors while preserving highlights and outlines.

ice_floor:minion/iseal1.rationale: Unified rose-violet hue for both cyan ice and brown thawed bodies, with mild midtone tinting across all three stages.

ice_floor:minion/isloth1.rationale: The preview turned the first two icy coats pink but the burgundy thaw stage green. Map chromatic coat colors across all three stages to rose; preserve white snow highlights and dark outlines.

ice_floor:minion/iunicorn1.rationale: Maps the pale ice and water across all three stages to rose quartz; the full chromatic mask and light neutral midtone tint catch the gray thaw stage while preserving bright highlights.

ophan:minion/holyeye1.rationale: Rotates the golden rings and orbital frames into azure and indigo while retaining the pale eye centers and dark outlines through all three forms.

stingaray:minion/waterray1.rationale: Moves the large blue dorsal and wing surfaces of both rays toward green-lime, leaving dark navy undersides and water effects for contrast.

zanyu:minion/dirtfish.rationale: Brings the muted blue-gray fish and water into an amber-orange palette with a restrained neutral midtone tint; dark armor edges and bright water highlights remain readable.
